metadata.processing_notes: Comprehensive extraction from 49 British colony files. Data extracted for geographic entities, personnel with titles and salaries, institutions, economic indicators, infrastructure, demographics, and historical events. All information extracted exactly as written in source documents with no modernization of historical spelling or terminology.

notes: Summary of extraction: This comprehensive knowledge graph extraction from the Colonial Office List 1900 includes data from all 49 colonies and territories. Geographic entities include colony boundaries, coordinates, areas, and major cities. Personnel data includes names, titles (Sir, Dr., Rev., etc.), honors (K.C.M.G., C.B., etc.), positions, locations, and salaries in pounds sterling with allowances. Institutions include executive councils, legislative councils, courts, and departments with composition details. Economic data encompasses revenue and expenditure figures, trade statistics, shipping data, and currency information. Infrastructure includes railways, telegraph systems, postal routes, and dock facilities with construction costs and revenues. Demographics provide population data with breakdowns by ethnicity and religion as recorded in the original documents. Historical events document significant dates from discovery through 1900, including treaties, transfers, establishments, and constitutional changes.
